about: The 3D of StormBASIC's virtual machine (STORMVM.DLL, or the same code in a game's _lnk.DLL): meshes drawn as textured quads and triangles with a depth buffer, a colour key and a distance shade.

hooks.note: RenderScene, after it set the view (r0 nonzero when there is one). u32(sp + 0x24) is the renderer, which holds the picture the 3D is drawn into (12-bit colours, 176 by 208).
RenderScene returns: every mesh is drawn; the game draws its 2D after this.
The polygon's texture, its size and the colour table.
A quad (grids: floors, terrain), opaque, with the depth buffer.
A quad (grids: floors, terrain), opaque, without the depth buffer.
A quad (grids: floors, terrain), half the texel over half the picture, with the depth buffer.
A quad (grids: floors, terrain), half the texel over half the picture, without the depth buffer.
A rectangle on the screen (billboards: plants, signs), opaque; always the depth buffer and the colour key.
A rectangle on the screen (billboards: plants, signs), half the texel over half the picture; always the depth buffer and the colour key.
Replacing: the rasteriser returns at once, so the guest draws none of the polygon.
The polygon's texture, its size and the colour table.
A triangle (models), opaque, with the depth buffer.
A triangle (models), opaque, without the depth buffer.

Replacing: the rasteriser returns at once, so the guest draws none of the polygon.
